articles.title: Record CEO credits strategic transformation as assets under management hit record $130.3bn
articles.summary: Record PLC (LSE:REC) CEO Dr Jan Hendrik Witte talked with Proactive about the specialist asset manager's strong half-year results, record assets under management and progress in its strategic transformation. Revenue rose 19% to £22.8 million, while profit after tax increased 49% to £5.6 million. Assets under management reached a record $130.3 billion, supported by $12.7 billion in net inflows across its three product pillars: risk management, absolute return and private markets. Witte explained how Record is building on its established foreign exchange expertise while expanding into higher-growth absolute return and private market strategies to improve the quality of earnings. He highlighted growing demand for customised investment solutions from institutional investors, including pension funds, asset managers and family offices, amid geopolitical uncertainty and changing market conditions. Operating margins increased to 32.3%, with further improvements possible as the strategy develops. Witte also discussed the revised dividend policy, targeting a 40% to 60% payout of annual profits, balancing shareholder returns with investment in future growth.
